title: tools: Add multiple commit support to validate-commit.py [skip ci]
description:
(cherry picked from commit 7fda930fe71bfe3a6aa53421fced438eb25554e4)

Co-authored-by: Gerald Combs <gerald@wireshark.org>

Skipping CI so that the very bug for which this is one step of the
fix won't block the merge.

notes.body: removed this merge request from the merge train because the pipeline did not succeed. [Learn more](https://gitlab.com/help/ci/pipelines/merge_trains.md#merge-request-dropped-from-the-merge-train).
That was not sufficient to prevent a buggy validate-commit from refusing to validate a change that, along with other changes to make this script the same as the 4.6 one, may fix the bugs in question.
